project_name: DOOH Passenger Auto Advertising Network Platform
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / OPERATIONS CONTROL ROOM

design_philosophy.theme: Dark operations mode default for admin/ops, crisp responsive clean mode for advertisers and mobile drivers/techs
principles: Tactical Control Room Aesthetics: High visibility, dense metrics, clear status indicators without visual noise
Unified Entity Anchors: Single-click navigation across Auto -> Screen -> Device -> SIM -> Campaign -> Driver
Strict Semantic Color Coding: Green for online/active, Amber for warning/under-delivery, Red for offline/critical, Blue for programmatic/in-review
Zero Visual Slop: High contrast, 1px subtle tactical borders, crisp typography pairing, zero default rounded-xl gradients

hierarchy.h1_page_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold font-heading tracking-tight text-slate-100
hierarchy.h2_section_header: text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold font-heading tracking-wide text-slate-200 uppercase

header.specs: Sticky top-0 z-40 h-16 bg-[#0B0F17]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10 px-4 sm:px-6 flex items-center justify-between
elements: Role Switcher / Simulator (Super Admin, Ops, Advertiser, Driver, Tech)
Notification Bell with live unread badge

sidebar.specs: Fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen w-64 bg-[#070A10] border-r border-white/10 flex flex-col z-50

content_wrapper.specs: pl-64 pt-16 min-h-screen bg-[#0B0F17] p-6 space-y-6

kpi_cards.classes: bg-[#111827] border border-white/10 rounded-lg p-5 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-white/20 transition-all
kpi_cards.structure: Top: Title + Icon; Middle: Big Metric (font-mono) + Subtitle; Bottom: Mini Sparkline / Trend Badge

data_tables.thead: bg-[#172033] text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 border-b border-white/10

buttons.primary: bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-sm transition-all shadow-md active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-white/10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-sm transition-all
buttons.danger: bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-sm transition-all

forms.input_classes: w-full bg-[#172033] border border-white/10 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500
forms.select_classes: w-full bg-[#172033] border border-white/10 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500

image_urls.description: Auto rickshaw at night with digital display ambience
Urban DOOH auto rickshaw advertising fleet in city streets

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, selects, tabs, status badges, menu items, table rows, modal triggers MUST have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='create-campaign-btn', data-testid='kpi-active-autos-count').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rule: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for body copy against dark card backgrounds.
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_nav: Global search openable with '/' key, modals closeable with ESC key.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade DOOH fleet management platform with server-rendered HTML/Blade, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js, and Chart.js
Ensure all role dashboards (Super Admin, Ops, Finance, Advertiser, Driver Mobile, Technician Mobile) are easily accessible via role switcher in top header
Strictly follow the color semantics and typography scales defined in this file
Include data-testid on every interactive element and data card for automated validation
